author: mrmattwhite
quote:
Obviously this isn't the worst game ever, there is plenty to appreciate. I wouldn't give it 1 out of 10 were it not for ENORMOUS disappointment of what could've/should've been.

The glitches and frame rate are simply not good enough after THIRTEEN YEARS of development.

The story is tedious, the characters are boring. Gameplay is largely dull cut scenes with brief menial tasks in between.

And the real heartbreaking part, they've completely neutered the game. A lot of the usual GTA mayhem is either completely prohibited or locked behind story gameplay. You can't crash planes, you can't even steal expensive cars (literally taking the grand theft auto out of grand theft auto). 

The franchise has abandoned it's USP, it's not special anymore. I'm sorely disappointed. Shame on the developers. RIP GTA
